svg.title: Issue 1 — Page 2 — Panel 3: Sable + Thresh face each other through bridge arch
svg.desc: Medium two-shot, profile, 50mm. Sable on bridge side (left), Thresh in corridor opposite (right), framed by central archway. Sable in pristine silver suit gives a micro-nod of acknowledgment; she trusts this soldier completely. Thresh in pristine ruby-crimson suit at ease, broad-shouldered, copper-red buzz cut, micro-confident: a soldier radiating competence and calm. KEY "Thresh-was-confident" beat — pre-fear-arc baseline. Bridge blue-white on Sable's side meets corridor crimson on Thresh's — the two colors meeting in the archway between them, foreshadowing later division. THRESH: "Kit's locked. Good to drop." / SABLE: "Appreciated, Thresh."
